task.description:
Fix the SCH-02 integration test compile blockers reported by the SCH-02 test run.

Primary diagnostics to address:
- tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig:174:9 local variable is never mutated; use const
- tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig:202:34 expected '*Scheduler', found '*const Scheduler'
- tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig:278:42 expected '*Scheduler', found '*const Scheduler'
- tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig:385:18 expected '*Scheduler', found '*const Scheduler'

Adjust the test code and any necessary scheduler API typing to remove the const mismatch without regressing SCH-02 behavior. Keep the fix minimal and focused.

Validation requirements:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- zig build test-integration exits 0
acceptance_criteria: SCH-02 integration tests compile and run

result.summary: Resolved the SCH-02 integration blockers by making the scheduler/task cancellation API const-correct, fixing the SCH-02 test locals, and stopping the scheduler from spinning forever on a skipped advisory-locked timer. zig build, zig build test, and zig build test-integration all exit 0.
